description: This file defines classes related to tracing and scope management within the PyTorch FX framework, specifically for quantization workflows. It includes the QuantizationTracer class which extends FX's Tracer to customize module skipping logic during tracing.

classes.name: ScopeContextManager
classes.description: A subclass of torch.fx.proxy.ScopeContextManager that initializes scope with the current module path and type.

classes.name: QuantizationTracer
classes.description: A custom FX tracer for quantization, with logic to decide which modules are leaf modules based on their module path, type, and class.

methods.description: Constructor for ScopeContextManager and QuantizationTracer, initializing with relevant parameters.

methods.name: bool is_leaf_module(self, m: torch.nn.Module, module_qualified_name: str)
methods.description: Determines if a module should be considered a leaf during FX tracing, based on module characteristics.
